function.name: calculate_derivative
function.description: Calculate the derivative of a polynomial function. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

x_value.description: The x-value at which the derivative is calculated. Optional, default to 0.00. This is a float type value.

message.content:
對於多項式 \(f(x)=3x^{2}+2x-1\)，使用冪律（Power Rule）：

\[
\dfrac{d}{dx}\bigl(ax^{n}\bigr)=an\,x^{\,n-1}
\]

逐項求導得到  

* \(\displaystyle \frac{d}{dx}(3x^{2})=3\times2\,x^{2-1}=6x\)
* \(\displaystyle \frac{d}{dx}(2x)=2\times1\,x^{1-1}=2\)
* 常數 \(-1\) 的導數為 \(0\)

將各項相加，得

\[
f'(x)=6x+2 .
\]

因此，\(3x^{2}+2x-1\) 的導數是 **\(6x+2\)**。
